of chunam (Kj - see Section 4.2) and the crack spacing (see equation 5.14).

Having established the methodology for this estimation procedure, a
limited crack survey was undertaken to present an evaluation of chunam
performance based on the model procedure outlined. It is to be noted that
a laboratory investigation in which the principal aim was to validate the
model predictions (equations 5.7-5.9) had been initiated but was incomplete
at the time of writing.
